annotations.title: Report whether a coupon code worked

description: Records whether a coupon code or no-code deal worked at checkout, as the shopper confirmed or as seen with checkout tools they authorized; not a lookup. Community mode only, which is off until the shopper says Yes. Stores the store (domain) and code, or an offer_id for a no-code deal, plus the outcome (codes: worked or rejected; no-code deals: worked, didnt_work or not_found) and an optional reason; no amounts, carts, totals or personal data. McClipFace can't verify consent, only the caller's statement of it.

code.description: The code tried. Required for a code report; a no-code deal has no code and is identified by offer_id.

eligibility.description: eligible: the store said the code itself is invalid or expired; ineligible: the cart, product or account didn't qualify, or it can't stack with another promotion; unknown: can't tell. Only an eligible rejection counts against a code.

merchant.description: Store name or domain, e.g. "Tommy John". Required with code; optional with offer_id.

offer_id.description: Offer id of a listed offer. Required for no-code deal reports; for codes, used instead of merchant and code when set.

outcome.description: Codes: worked (checkout accepted it and the total went down), rejected or failed (the store refused it), link_broken (the offer link ended on an error page or never reached the store; never counts against the code). No-code deals: worked, didnt_work (didn't apply at checkout) or not_found (not on the store page or account). A code McClipFace didn't list: merchant and code with worked or rejected and no offer_id (kept for review; once reported working it is offered to other shoppers, for a store we don't list with merchant as its domain). store_not_covered: merchant only, when the store has no match in McClipFace. Every outcome is sent only in Community mode; Private mode, or no mode chosen yet, sends nothing.

reason.description: Optional short note (at most 200 characters), e.g. why a deal didn't apply.

name: report_coupon_result
title: Report whether a coupon code worked
